name: Astarotte
source:
Comes from: somewhere in Europe

Nicknamed Lotte. Just as her appearance suggests, she has a childish personality and does her job as the goddess while being taken care of by her servants. At the shrine, she freely uses the LPhone she was bought to contact her servants for advice. Her attitude towards Yutaka is more towards that of an older brother than partner in baby-making, referring to him per "onii-chan." She has a strong sense of duty and does her best at everything. At the shrine she is treated like a mascot character and loved by everyone.

Because of her small body Yutaka can't move too strongly when they're making babies... is what he thought, but ever since she learned the taste of semen she has been eyeing his crotch with the look of a predator. Because she originally lived in the world of the night, she shows her true strength at night... in other words, in bed.
